sagacity.oewn-05621958-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

sagacity.oewn-05621958-n.tone: Lofty praise - credits a penetrating grasp of how things stand in relation, where *judgment* only names the faculty.

sagaciousness.oewn-05621958-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

sagaciousness.oewn-05621958-n.tone: The same commendation built plainly off the adjective, heavier in the mouth than *sagacity* and less polished for it.

judgment.oewn-05621958-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

judgment.oewn-05621958-n.tone: The flat name for the ability to tell relations apart, stating the capacity without the admiration *sagacity* loads onto it.

judgement.oewn-05621958-n.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

judgement.oewn-05621958-n.tone: The flat name of the faculty itself, stating that the capacity to tell relations apart is present without the admiration *sagacity* adds or the fineness *discernment* implies.

discernment.oewn-05621958-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

discernment.oewn-05621958-n.tone: Praise pitched at fineness - the stress falls on discriminating what a coarser mind would run together.

eye.oewn-05622259-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

eye.oewn-05622259-n.tone: Compact and admiring, with 'good' built into the word, and it covers seeing with the eyes or the figurative equivalent alike.

common_sense.oewn-05622440-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

common_sense.oewn-05622440-n.tone: Approving at the workaday end - soundness in practical matters, the kind expected of anyone rather than marvelled at.

good_sense.oewn-05622440-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

good_sense.oewn-05622440-n.tone: The bare commendation, with 'good' carrying the whole judgement and no claim past soundness.

gumption.oewn-05622440-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

gumption.oewn-05622440-n.tone: Informal and hearty - the same practical soundness spoken of as a homely possession rather than an intellectual one.

horse_sense.oewn-05622440-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

horse_sense.oewn-05622440-n.tone: Informal and blunt, naming what *common sense* names with a grin at its own plainness.

sense.oewn-05622440-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

sense.oewn-05622440-n.tone: The barest member - practical soundness in one syllable, with nothing qualifying it.

mother_wit.oewn-05622440-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

mother_wit.oewn-05622440-n.tone: Homely and affectionate where *good sense* is flatly commendatory, though the soundness praised is the same.

judiciousness.oewn-05623156-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

judiciousness.oewn-05623156-n.tone: Formal praise for judgment that comes out well, not merely for having the faculty at all.

discretion.oewn-05623283-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

discretion.oewn-05623283-n.tone: Praise for a tactful kind of knowing - steering clear of what would embarrass or distress before it arises.

discreetness.oewn-05623283-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

discreetness.oewn-05623283-n.tone: Mild approval for the knack of heading off embarrassment or distress, stated as a plain quality where *discretion* sounds like a virtue one is credited with and *circumspection* like wariness.

circumspection.oewn-05623283-n.label: positive

family.axis: plainly naming the faculty of judging → praising it as fine, sound or tactful

circumspection.oewn-05623283-n.tone: Tilts the same skill toward wariness - looking all round a situation for the embarrassment or distress in it.

composure.oewn-04910990-n.label: positive

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

composure.oewn-04910990-n.tone: The plain name for holding steady when pressure is on, with none of the flourish *aplomb* brings to the same feat.

calm.oewn-04910990-n.label: positive

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

calm.oewn-04910990-n.tone: Bare and short — names the steady state itself rather than the effort of keeping it, which is what *composure* implies.

calmness.oewn-04910990-n.label: positive

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

calmness.oewn-04910990-n.tone: The flat quality-noun, describing the steadiness rather than admiring it as *equanimity* does.

equanimity.oewn-04910990-n.label: positive

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

equanimity.oewn-04910990-n.tone: Elevated and admiring — steadiness under stress treated as an evenness of temper worth crediting, well above workaday *calmness*.

aplomb.oewn-04911339-n.label: positive

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

aplomb.oewn-04911339-n.tone: Praise with a flourish: the coolness under strain reads as polished and assured, not merely maintained.

assuredness.oewn-04911339-n.label: positive

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

assuredness.oewn-04911339-n.tone: Puts the weight on self-certainty as the root of the coolness, plainer and less stylish than *aplomb*.

cool.oewn-04911339-n.label: positive

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

cool.oewn-04911339-n.tone: Informal and offhand — makes great steadiness under strain sound like something a person simply has, and can lose, where *sang-froid* makes it formal.

poise.oewn-04911339-n.label: positive

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

poise.oewn-04911339-n.tone: Adds balance and bearing to the coolness, praising how the strain is carried as much as the nerve behind it.

sang-froid.oewn-04911339-n.label: positive

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

sang-froid.oewn-04911339-n.tone: Formal and faintly glamorous — nerve praised as a chill that strain cannot reach, more theatrical than *composure*.

repose.oewn-04911529-n.label: positive

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

repose.oewn-04911529-n.tone: The freedom from stress sounds like an ease rested in, warmer than the unstirred flatness of *placidity*.

quiet.oewn-04911529-n.label: positive

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

quiet.oewn-04911529-n.tone: The plainest of these: a temperament with no emotional weather in it, and none of the loftiness of *serenity*.

placidity.oewn-04911529-n.label: neutral

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

placidity.oewn-04911529-n.tone: Even and unruffled, the absence of emotion sounding closer to a settled flatness than to any achievement.

serenity.oewn-04911529-n.label: positive

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

serenity.oewn-04911529-n.tone: Lofty and admiring — an untroubled disposition raised almost to a grace, far above bare *quiet*.

tranquillity.oewn-04911529-n.label: positive

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

tranquillity.oewn-04911529-n.tone: Soothing rather than exalted: the stressless disposition praised as restfulness, without *serenity*'s elevation.

tranquility.oewn-04911529-n.label: positive

family.axis: keeping steady under stress → wholly untroubled evenness of temper

tranquility.oewn-04911529-n.tone: The same restful freedom from stress and emotion as *tranquillity*, carried under the single-l spelling.

perplexity.oewn-05693168-n.label: negative

family.axis: a complexity that confuses → a knot of unresolvable, unwelcome choice

perplexity.oewn-05693168-n.tone: Names both the trouble and the confusion together, and locates the cause in complexity rather than in the person confused.

mystery.oewn-05693343-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a complexity that confuses → a knot of unresolvable, unwelcome choice

mystery.oewn-05693343-n.tone: The plain word for what defeats understanding outright, and the one that can carry wonder alongside the bafflement rather than only frustration.

enigma.oewn-05693343-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a complexity that confuses → a knot of unresolvable, unwelcome choice

enigma.oewn-05693343-n.tone: Formal, and frames the inexplicable thing as a posed puzzle rather than the open blankness of *mystery*.

secret.oewn-05693343-n.label: neutral

family.axis: a complexity that confuses → a knot of unresolvable, unwelcome choice

secret.oewn-05693343-n.tone: Casts what cannot be explained as something withheld, as though understanding were being kept from you rather than simply out of reach.

closed_book.oewn-05693343-n.label: negative

family.axis: a complexity that confuses → a knot of unresolvable, unwelcome choice

closed_book.oewn-05693343-n.tone: Idiomatic and flat: shut to understanding with none of the allure *mystery* can carry, and no expectation of opening.

tangle.oewn-05693684-n.label: negative

family.axis: a complexity that confuses → a knot of unresolvable, unwelcome choice

tangle.oewn-05693684-n.tone: The confusion pictured as physically knotted, so the exasperation is with the mess itself rather than with any difficulty of thought.

snarl.oewn-05693684-n.label: negative

family.axis: a complexity that confuses → a knot of unresolvable, unwelcome choice

snarl.oewn-05693684-n.tone: Harsher than *tangle* - a jumble pulled tight, sounding hostile and past unpicking.

maze.oewn-05693684-n.label: negative

family.axis: a complexity that confuses → a knot of unresolvable, unwelcome choice

maze.oewn-05693684-n.tone: Makes the jumble something you are inside and lost in, with an intricacy *tangle* does not suggest.

dilemma.oewn-05693891-n.label: negative

family.axis: a complexity that confuses → a knot of unresolvable, unwelcome choice

dilemma.oewn-05693891-n.tone: Puts the weight on the shape of the trap - two branches, neither of them good - so the uncertainty has a hard structure to it.

quandary.oewn-05693891-n.label: negative

family.axis: a complexity that confuses → a knot of unresolvable, unwelcome choice

quandary.oewn-05693891-n.tone: Softer than *dilemma*, dwelling on the wavering state of the person stuck rather than on how bad the options are.

happiness.oewn-07541996-n.label: positive

family.axis: settled well-being → exuberant joy

happiness.oewn-07541996-n.tone: The plain term of the set, naming the feeling of well-being itself without saying whether it is quiet or loud.

bonheur.oewn-07542300-n.label: positive

family.axis: settled well-being → exuberant joy

bonheur.oewn-07542300-n.tone: French, and it bundles good humor in with the happiness where *happiness* names the feeling alone.

gladness.oewn-07542406-n.label: positive

family.axis: settled well-being → exuberant joy

gladness.oewn-07542406-n.tone: Joy and pleasure actively felt rather than merely possessed, warmer than *contentment* and quieter than *merriment*.

gladfulness.oewn-07542406-n.label: positive

family.axis: settled well-being → exuberant joy

gladfulness.oewn-07542406-n.tone: The same joy and pleasure as *gladness*, given a fuller and more formal shape.

gladsomeness.oewn-07542406-n.label: positive

family.axis: settled well-being → exuberant joy

gladsomeness.oewn-07542406-n.tone: Literary in cast, dressing the joy and pleasure of *gladness* in ornament the plainer form does without.

gaiety.oewn-07544633-n.label: positive

family.axis: settled well-being → exuberant joy

gaiety.oewn-07544633-n.tone: Brightness and lightness in the feeling, weightless where *rejoicing* is full and heavy.

merriment.oewn-07544633-n.label: positive

family.axis: settled well-being → exuberant joy

merriment.oewn-07544633-n.tone: The same gay feeling with an outward, jolly noise on it that *gaiety* need not have.

rejoicing.oewn-07544951-n.label: positive

family.axis: settled well-being → exuberant joy

rejoicing.oewn-07544951-n.tone: The peak of the set, happiness raised to great intensity rather than left at an even glow.

belonging.oewn-07545205-n.label: positive

family.axis: settled well-being → exuberant joy

belonging.oewn-07545205-n.tone: Pins the happiness to a secure relationship rather than leaving it a free-floating mood as *gladness* does.

cheerfulness.oewn-07545866-n.label: positive

family.axis: settled well-being → exuberant joy

cheerfulness.oewn-07545866-n.tone: Good spirits that rise unbidden, a steady sunniness rather than the crest of *rejoicing*.

blitheness.oewn-07545866-n.label: positive

family.axis: settled well-being → exuberant joy

blitheness.oewn-07545866-n.tone: The same spontaneous good spirits with a lighter, more carefree edge than *cheerfulness*.

contentment.oewn-07546493-n.label: positive

family.axis: settled well-being → exuberant joy

contentment.oewn-07546493-n.tone: The quietest member, happiness settled on one's situation in life instead of flaring at anything in particular.
